lovablePrompt:
UPDATE THE EXISTING GOODARZITRADING WEBSITE — DO NOT REBUILD OR DELETE EXISTING CONTENT.

Implement the attached Knowledge Center master JSON as a three-level reference system:

LEVEL 1: Knowledge Center master index
LEVEL 2: Category page / expandable list
LEVEL 3: Individual instrument/rule/contract detail page

Example:
Knowledge → Incoterms 2020 → 11 rules → CIF → complete CIF detail.

Requirements:
- English default; Persian and Arabic fully supported.
- Persian/Arabic RTL; English legal names, abbreviations and codes LTR where appropriate.
- No language mixing.
- Keep the existing dedicated Incoterms menu/page.
- Incoterms 2020 must contain all 11 rules, each with its own detail page.
- ITC must preserve the eight model-contract families from the supplied ITC publication.
- Use the registry in this JSON as the core legal-information catalogue.
- Search + category filter + instrument-type filter.
- Each detail page must show official title, type, scope, conditions of application, key provisions, limitations, official source, last verified date and disclaimer.

LEGAL ACCURACY IS NON-NEGOTIABLE:
This system contains legal information that may affect commercial decisions. Never invent treaty status, Iran membership, dates, applicability or legal conclusions. Never state that an instrument applies to a transaction without checking its conditions, participating States, declarations/reservations and applicable national law. Never present general information as transaction-specific legal advice. Never claim a model contract is universally sufficient. Use primary/official sources first. Show source and last-verified date on every instrument page. If a point is not verified, display 'Verification required' rather than guessing.

PRINT/PDF BRANDING:
- Use ONLY the user's existing real GoodarziTrading logo asset.
- No extra logo at the left of content pages.
- Large, very faint centered watermark behind content.
- Footer on every page: GoodarziTrading + https://www.goodarzitrading.ir + page number.
- Print/PDF repeats watermark and footer on every page.
- Never obscure legal text.

DO NOT remove or overwrite existing website content, routes, products, services, styling, or the current three-language system.

entries.scope: Applicability depends on ratification status per member state and the specific tariff line — must be verified from the official ECO source before use.

title.en: Iran–Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) Free Trade Agreement

entries.administeringBody: Eurasian Economic Union / Islamic Republic of Iran

summary.en: Preferential trade agreement between Iran and EAEU member states (Russia, Armenia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan) covering reduced tariffs on a scheduled list of goods. Status upgraded from interim to full FTA in recent years; exact product coverage, tariff rates and current entry-into-force status must be verified from an official/primary source before any transactional reliance.

entries.scope: Product-line-specific tariff preferences; must be checked against the current official schedule, not assumed to apply generally.

entries.administeringBody: Institute of London Underwriters / Lloyd's Market Association (LMA) & International Underwriting Association (IUA)

summary.en: Widely used standard clauses defining scope of marine cargo insurance cover (All Risks / named perils / minimum cover), commonly referenced alongside CIF and CIP Incoterms. Not an international convention — a market-standard wording; exact current edition and wording must be confirmed from the official LMA/IUA source.

entries.scope: Contractual insurance wording chosen by the parties/insurer; applicability is transaction-specific, not automatic.

title.en: UNIDROIT Principles of International Commercial Contracts

summary.en: Non-binding restatement of general contract-law principles, frequently chosen by parties (or applied by arbitral tribunals) to govern or interpret international commercial contracts, especially alongside or in gaps left by CISG. Current edition and precise text must be confirmed from UNIDROIT's official source.

entries.scope: Applies only if chosen by the parties or applied by a tribunal; not automatically binding law.

title.en: Geneva Convention on Agency in the International Sale of Goods (1983)

summary.en: Convention addressing the legal relationship created when an agent acts on behalf of a principal in international sale-of-goods transactions. Has a very limited number of ratifications and may not be in force at all — ratification/in-force status must be verified from an official source before any reliance.

entries.scope: Extremely limited ratification; do not assume applicability without checking current status.

translationIntegrityNote.rule: Do NOT auto-generate or machine-translate fa/ar legal summaries as a substitute for reviewed content. Where fa/ar summary is empty, the UI must either (a) display the English summary with a clearly labeled 'Not yet available in this language' note, or (b) display 'نیازمند بررسی و تأیید از منبع رسمی' / 'قيد المراجعة والتحقق من مصدر رسمي' — never silently invent translated legal content.

completenessNote.en: This registry is a curated starting set, not an exhaustive index of every international trade instrument. Categories marked displayStatus='coming_soon' currently have no entries and must not be presented to site visitors as 'no such instruments exist' — they should show a clear 'content under development' state instead.
